> | | | -- SHADOWING -------------------------------------------- <repl>

The local name `r` shadows an imported, builtin, or top-level value.

2|     r = 5.0
       ^
| | | -- SHADOWING -------------------------------------------- <repl>

The local name `x` shadows an imported, builtin, or top-level value.

2|     x = 9
       ^
